notes.title: Feature Update & Achievement Fix 8/4
notes.content:
Feature Updates & Achievement Fixes August 4
Thank you for your support. We've made the following updates to address your concerns!
1. Mini-games can now be skipped after achieving a perfect score.
a. After completing a 4/4 round of the stocking photo mini-game with all characters, re-enter to skip the game.
b. Chapter 3: Chen Chen's Heartbeat mini-game. After both characters are safe, re-enter to skip the game.
c. Chapter 4: Lu Mengxin's date with a scumbag. After watching the game, re-enter to skip the game.
d. Chapter 4: Jiang Jiu's movie theater popcorn throwing mini-game. After successfully throwing the popcorn, re-enter to skip the game.
e. Chapter 4: Chen Chen's tennis mini-game. After winning the game, re-enter to skip the game.
f. Chapter 5: The hidden ending, the pajama party scoring segment. After watching the game, re-enter to skip the game.
2. Achievements:
a. Fixed the triggering logic for the achievement "Unconfirmed Feelings": Obtained after completing Chapter 4.
b. Fixed the triggering logic for the achievement "It Has to Be You": Jiang Jiu's trap BE is no longer counted.
3. Fixed a bug in the ending UI video background sound.

notes.title: Bug Fix Notice
notes.content:
[b]In response to the enthusiastic support and suggestions from players, here are some clarifications on some of the issues we've collected:

1. Insufficient video clarity: The current video is in 1440p, and the default window has been increased to 2560*1440. The blurry video may be due to skin smoothing and insufficient lighting. We're looking into whether we can make some adjustments without affecting the character's appearance. We're also preparing a 4K video DLC.

2. The Chapter 3 flowchart is confusing: This issue is known and we're working on a fix.

3. How to enter Chapter 4: Since our game has a linear storyline, you need to successfully date three women over the three days of Chapter 3 to enter the Beta stage.

4. Regarding the locked ending: Currently, even if you've seen the ending, it won't be unlocked in the flowchart. This issue is known and a fix is in the works.

5. Regarding the inability to skip mini-games: This feature has been added.[/b]
